q2_gaps: sub-month vague temporal modifier ('early April', 'late May', 'mid-June'): Time's structured terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute with no way to record 'early', so the modifier is dropped

tense scoping over a deontic modal ('had to be cleared'): the tense marker sits on the modal (the obligation was past), but the only licensed placement is (Past e) on the event, which asserts that the clearing occurred - the text states only the requirement

episodic (existential) bare plural subject ('legal hurdles had to be cleared', 'sales could resume'): the instruction set assigns a bare plural the GENERIC reading (Inheritance / a distributing rule) and gives no rule for a bare plural naming specific things in a past episode, so the group-witness route used here is an extension
circumstantial / dynamic necessity ('had to' = it was necessary that, no norm-giver): 'must' is mapped only onto epistemic Must or deontic Obligated, with no third operator
notes: Before-ordering ('after X' swapped, 'before Z' direct), the agentless passive, the 'legal' distribution rule over group members, and the Obligated/Can status atoms all follow the instruction set. Group stem sk_hurdle_1/sk_sales_1 is a mnemonic stem, which the group-witness rule permits.
